newsitem.title: USA: SpecTran files for 1.8 mln common shares.
newsitem.headline: SpecTran files for 1.8 mln common shares.

text.p: SpecTran Corp said Thursday it filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to 1.8 million common shares.
Of the total, 1.45 million common will be sold by the company and 350,000 common will be offered by selling stockholders, the filing said. Outstanding shares will total 7,200,071 common.

The company has granted the underwriters a 30 day overallotment option to purchase up to 270,000 additional common shares. The offering will be made through Tucker Anthony Inc and Raymond James & Associates Inc.
Proceeds will be used for the expansion of manufacturing capacity, working capital and general corporate purposes, the company said in the filing.
SpecTran, of Sturbridge, Mass., develops, manufactures and markets high quality optical fiber, optical fiber cables and value-added optical fiber components and assemblies.
